name: CPU Backend
description: The reference RenderBackend: every op runs through CoreRaster, so its pixels are CoreRaster's pixels. Surfaces are PixelBuffers in a locked store keyed by surface id. Display and composite run in RB-3; the other families throw unsupported until RB-4.

relationships.description: every CPU op calls CoreRaster; CoreRaster's errors map to RenderError.raster
